cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(doa3_game C)

# Dead or Alive 3 - Recompiled game executable (boot bring-up host)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# ── Recompiled function sources (auto-generated) ──────────────
# Generated by: py -3 -m tools.recomp ../doa3gamefiles/default.xbe --all --split 1000
file(GLOB RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp/gen/recomp_*.c"
)

# Guest registers in C locals (tools/recomp/localize_regs.py). In the
# generated code every x86 register and the x87 stack are globals and every
# guest memory access is volatile, so the compiler keeps the register file in
# memory, reloading it after almost every access. The pass rewrites a copy of
# each generated chunk so a function's body works on locals, synchronised
# with the globals at every call and return. The copies are made at build
# time (Python 3) in the build tree; without Python the originals are built.
option(DOA3_LOCAL_REGS "Keep guest registers in locals in the recompiled code (needs Python 3 at build time)" ON)
set(DOA3_LOCAL_REGS_ACTIVE OFF)
if(DOA3_LOCAL_REGS)
    find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)
    if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
        set(_loc_dir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/gen_local")
        file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${_loc_dir}")
        set(_loc_script "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/recomp/localize_regs.py")
        set(_loc_sources "")
        foreach(_src ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES})
            get_filename_component(_name "${_src}" NAME)
            if(_name MATCHES "^recomp_[0-9]+\\.c$")
                set(_out "${_loc_dir}/${_name}")
                add_custom_command(OUTPUT "${_out}"
                    COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}" "${_loc_script}" --out "${_out}" "${_src}"
                    DEPENDS "${_src}" "${_loc_script}"
                    COMMENT "Registers to locals: ${_name}"
                    VERBATIM)
                list(APPEND _loc_sources "${_out}")
            else()
                list(APPEND _loc_sources "${_src}")
            endif()
        endforeach()
        set(RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES ${_loc_sources})
        set(DOA3_LOCAL_REGS_ACTIVE ON)
        message(STATUS "DOA3: recompiled code built with registers in locals")
    else()
        message(WARNING "DOA3: Python 3 not found; recompiled code built without the register pass (slower)")
    endif()
endif()

# ── NV2A GPU emulation (from xemu) — FULL stack, mirrors burnout3 ──
set(NV2A_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src/nv2a")
set(NV2A_SOURCES
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_core.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_mmio_hook.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_pb_test.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_pgraph_d3d11.c
    ${NV2A_DIR}/nv2a_vertex_program.c
    # nv2a_pb_replay.c -- Burnout 3 menu-replay harness, unreachable from DOA3
)

# Game host sources
set(GAME_SOURCES
    main.c
    ../perf_capture.c
    ../perf_frame_log.c
    doa3.rc                  # window/taskbar/exe icon
    movie_present.c
    video_settings.c
    audio_settings.c
    game_audio.c
    debug_settings.c
    save_compat.c
    free_camera.c
    combat_debug.c
    training_dummy.c
    log_settings.c           # log files on/off (Esc menu, doa3_settings.ini)
    xiso_extract.c           # first-run install of the game files from a disc image
    recomp/recomp_manual.c
    burnout_compat_stubs.c   # inert stubs for burnout-only symbols the nv2a srcs need
    ${NV2A_SOURCES}
    ${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES}
)

add_executable(doa3 ${GAME_SOURCES})

# Link compatibility layers (mirrors burnout3)
target_link_libraries(doa3 PRIVATE
    xbox_kernel
    d3d8_compat
    dsound_compat
    input_compat
    apu_emu
    doa3_ui
    doa3_online
)

# System libraries (mirrors burnout3)
target_link_libraries(doa3 PRIVATE
    kernel32
    user32
    gdi32
    d3d11
    dxgi
)

# Include paths
target_include_directories(doa3 PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/recomp/gen
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/third_party
    ${NV2A_DIR}
)

# Development aid: per-function guest-stack checks, the DOA3_PROF call
# profile and DOA3_TRACE_FN (gen/recomp_probes.c). Off by default: every
# guest call pays for them, and ordinary builds only need the wrappers'
# fiber scheduling point.
option(DOA3_PROBES "Build the guest-stack probes and call profiler into every recompiled function" OFF)
if(DOA3_PROBES)
    target_compile_definitions(doa3 PRIVATE DOA3_PROBES=1)
endif()
if(DOA3_LOCAL_REGS_ACTIVE)
    target_compile_definitions(doa3 PRIVATE DOA3_LOCAL_REGS=1)
endif()

if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(doa3 PRIVATE
        /W3
        /WX-
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/O2>
        $<$<CONFIG:Debug>:/Ob2>
        $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:/O2>
    )
    set_property(TARGET doa3 PROPERTY MSVC_RUNTIME_CHECKS "")
    # Generated/recompiled code is mechanical: silence its warnings, and allow
    # the huge translation units (/bigobj).
    set_source_files_properties(${RECOMP_GEN_SOURCES} recomp/recomp_manual.c
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/w /bigobj")
    # NV2A emulation (from xemu) — silence its warnings too.
    set_source_files_properties(${NV2A_SOURCES} PROPERTIES COMPILE_FLAGS "/w")
    target_compile_definitions(doa3 PRIVATE _CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS)
    # Disable ASLR so Xbox memory can be mapped at fixed addresses.
    # Large stack: each Xbox call/ret becomes a native C call/return.
    target_link_options(doa3 PRIVATE
        /DYNAMICBASE:NO
        /FIXED:NO
        /MAP
        /DEBUG
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/SUBSYSTEM:WINDOWS>
        $<$<CONFIG:Release>:/ENTRY:mainCRTStartup>
        /STACK:33554432
        /LARGEADDRESSAWARE
    )
endif()

# Keep configuration outputs separate.
set_target_properties(doa3 PROPERTIES
    OUTPUT_NAME "DOA3"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bin"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/debug"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_RELEASE "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/release"
    PDB_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_DEBUG "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/debug"
)
